name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast for all interactive elements. This ensures keyboard users see clear focus at all times, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA for contrast. The trade-off is slightly larger visual weight, but it’s necessary for reliability across devices and reduced-motion modes.

name: Reader
text: Risk: 4px at 7:1 fails users toggling *both* reduced motion *and* high contrast—WCAG 2.2’s 3:1 minimum drops to 2:1 when motion is off. Keep 4px but raise contrast to 10:1 in reduced-motion mode; test with screen readers and keyboard-only users to confirm.
